# Security policy

PenguPool is pre-1.0. Security fixes are applied to the latest version on `main`; older releases are not maintained.

Please report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/nduwork/pengutool/security/advisories/new), rather than a public issue. Include the affected version, impact, and reproduction steps. The maintainer will coordinate a fix and disclosure with you.
